entries.title: Why I now, unfortunately, hate Hacker News..
entries.author: sw007
entries.current_title: Why I now, unfortunately, hate Hacker News..
entries.excerpt: I joined Hacker News around 5 years ago. I used to wake up and do the grim commute each morning to London from my home and the only thing that made it vaguely ok was Hacker News. It was a great place to go and find interesting articles from genuinely passionate people. It also used to be a really safe place to launch a startup that you'd spent days, weeks, years on - your project. It was a place where you could launch your startup and know you'd get great constructive feedbac
entries.guide_zh: 一位老用户解释自己为何从喜爱 HN 变得反感社区氛围。

entries.title: Ask PG: What made you change your mind about crowdfunding?
entries.author: dmarinoc
entries.current_title: Ask PG: What made you change your mind about crowdfunding?
entries.excerpt: Paul, Four months ago, in a thread about crowdfunding (http://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=3893783) you said that "having a very large number of inexperienced investors is the worst scenario possible." FundersClub is a YCS12 company, so I´m curious: what made you change your mind? The whole scenario? A different approach if an entity works like a proxy? Is there any secret sauce you can share?
entries.guide_zh: 此前担忧众筹、如今态度似乎不同，作者想知道 PG 改变看法的原因。

entries.title: Jury foreman says Apple patents valid due to different processor architecture
entries.author: bitcartel
entries.current_title: Jury foreman says Apple patents valid due to different processor architecture
entries.excerpt: If you listen carefully to his interview, from 1:30 for about 2 minutes, the foreman talks about the jury discussing the 460 patent and how it brought him back to his 'Aha' moment. "The software on the Apple side could not be placed into the processor on the prior art and vice versa. That means they are not interchangeable. That changed everything right there." http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c9cnQcTC2JY That's the reason why prior art was ignored!
entries.guide_zh: 作者引用陪审团长访谈，质疑其以处理器差异判断苹果专利的推理。

entries.title: Ask PG: Is RFS3 "Things built on Twitter" still sensible to prioritise?
entries.author: sjtgraham
entries.current_title: Ask PG: Is RFS3 "Things built on Twitter" still sensible to prioritise?
entries.excerpt: Given Twitter's capricious enforcement of its API Rules of the Road, their willingness to allegedly crib features from apps in their ecosystem, and increasingly misaligned incentives vis-a-vis 3rd party developers and users, how long is it before this RFS becomes inordinately risky for YC to specifically solicit?
entries.guide_zh: Twitter 平台规则多变，优先支持基于它创业的项目是否仍然合理？
